title: Adding epic order to user-story listings took the ?epic= query parameter and str.format()-ed it into a raw SQL subquery passed to queryset.extra(), enabling time-based blind SQL injection.

vulnerable_findings.explanation: User-controlled input from query parameters (epic_id) is directly interpolated into a SQL query without parameterization. The epic_id value comes from self.request.QUERY_PARAMS.get('epic', None) in the API view and is passed to attach_epic_order() where it is formatted directly into the SQL string using .format(). This allows SQL injection.

model = queryset.model
    sql = """SELECT "epics_relateduserstory"."order" AS "epic_order"
             FROM "epics_relateduserstory"
            WHERE "epics_relateduserstory"."user_story_id" = {tbl}.id and
                  "epics_relateduserstory"."epic_id" = {epic_id}"""

    sql = sql.format(tbl=model._meta.db_table, epic_id=epic_id)

findings.suggested_fix: Use Django ORM query methods or parameterized queries instead of string formatting. Replace the raw SQL with QuerySet filters: queryset.filter(epics_relateduserstory__epic_id=epic_id) or use Django's connection.cursor() with proper parameter placeholders (%s) and pass epic_id as a separate parameter list.

findings.explanation: The epic_id parameter is retrieved from user input (QUERY_PARAMS) and used to filter user stories and attach epic ordering information. There is no apparent authorization check to verify that the requesting user has permission to view or access data for the specified epic_id. This could allow a user to access ordering information or filtering for epics they shouldn't have access to (IDOR - Insecure Direct Object Reference).

findings.suggested_fix: Add authorization checks to verify that the user has permission to access the specified epic_id before using it in queries. This could include: (1) checking that the epic belongs to the same project as the user stories being queried, (2) verifying the user has project-level permissions to view the epic, or (3) filtering the epic_id through an authorized queryset before use.
